items.title: Is the window for local-first AI closing?
items.raw_excerpt: I've spent 20 years building backend systems and the last 12 on cloud infrastructure. Now I'm betting the other way. The thesis isn't "local AI is better." It's that the window to build credible alternatives is closing. Apple, Google, Amazon are all watching local inference become viable. Their response will be "local" AI that phones home - on-device processing with cloud-mandatory features, privacy marketing with telemetry requirements. Once those defaults ship, it doesn't matter if alternatives exist. Most people never look for options once something convenient is already there. Search, social, mobile, cloud - the pattern repeats. title_i18n.en: Is the window for local-first AI closing?
title_i18n.zh: 本地优先AI的窗口期正在关闭吗？
title_i18n.es: ¿Se está cerrando la ventana de oportunidad para la IA local-first?

excerpt_i18n.en: I've spent 20 years building backend systems and the last 12 on cloud infrastructure. Now I'm betting the other way. The thesis isn't "local AI is better." It's that the window to build credible alternatives is closing. Apple, Google, Amazon are all watching local inference become viable. Their response will be "local" AI that phones home - on-device processing with cloud-mandatory features, privacy marketing with telemetry requirements. Once those defaults ship, it doesn't matter if alternatives exist. Most people never look for options once something convenient is already there. Search, social, mobile, cloud - the pattern repeats. excerpt_i18n.zh: 我花了20年构建后端系统，过去12年专注于云基础设施。如今我正押注相反的方向。核心理念并非“本地AI更优”，而是构建可靠替代方案的窗口期正在关闭。
excerpt_i18n.es: He pasado 20 años construyendo sistemas backend y los últimos 12 en infraestructura en la nube. Ahora apuesto en la dirección contraria. La tesis no es "la IA local es mejor". Es que la ventana para construir alternativas creíbles se está cerrando.

items.title: Announcing OpenAI Grove Cohort 2
items.raw_excerpt: Applications are now open for OpenAI Grove Cohort 2, a 5-week founder program designed for individuals at any stage, from pre-idea to product. Participants receive $50K in API credits, early access to AI tools, and hands-on mentorship from the OpenAI team.

title_i18n.en: Announcing OpenAI Grove Cohort 2
title_i18n.zh: 宣布OpenAI Grove第二期学员名单
title_i18n.es: Anunciando la segunda cohorte de OpenAI Grove

excerpt_i18n.en: Applications are now open for OpenAI Grove Cohort 2, a 5-week founder program designed for individuals at any stage, from pre-idea to product. Participants receive $50K in API credits, early access to AI tools, and hands-on mentorship from the OpenAI team.
excerpt_i18n.zh: OpenAI Grove第二期创始人项目现已开放申请，该项目为期五周，面向从创意萌芽到产品落地的各阶段创业者。参与者将获得5万美元API额度、AI工具优先使用权及实践指导。
excerpt_i18n.es: Ya están abiertas las solicitudes para OpenAI Grove Cohort 2, un programa de emprendedores de 5 semanas diseñado para personas en cualquier etapa, desde la fase previa a la idea hasta el producto. Los participantes reciben 50.000 dólares en créditos de API, acceso anticipado a herramientas de IA y formación práctica.
